rooms.name: The Hall of Beginnings
rooms.description:
A quiet hall with whitewashed walls. Morning light falls through
a high window. A wide doorway leads north, out into a courtyard.

rooms.name: The Courtyard
rooms.description:
A small courtyard behind high walls. Beyond the gate in the north
wall you hear the sounds of a town.

items.name: an unlit torch
items.description: A simple torch of pine wood, wrapped in tarred cloth.

steps.text: Welcome! This short tutorial teaches you the basics (tutorial skip leaves it). Type look to see where you are.
There is a doorway to the north. Go through it with: go north (north, or just n, takes one step at a time).
Something lies on the ground here. Pick it up with: get torch
Check what you are carrying with: inventory (or just i)
Other players hear what you say in the same room. Try: say hello
Last step: help lists every command there is. Type help.

tutorial.done: Well done! You hand the torch to the gatekeeper, the gate opens, and you step out into Mudby.
